## Installation

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This will install the extension under the `_extensions` subdirectory.
If you are using version control, you will want to check in this directory.

Or install it from your editor with [Quarto Wizard](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-wizard):

<!--
AGENT GUIDELINES: when the repository ships a template.qmd, split this into two
sections, `quarto use template {{< var extension.reference >}}` first and
`quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}` second, and give each its own copy
of the button group below, /use?repo= under the first and /install?repo= under
the second. Both routes in get buttons; do not leave the second one as a bare
command.

Every install the site offers names a release tag. The two variables are
generated by _scripts/pre-render.sh from the extension manifest: `reference` is
what a reader types, and `wizard-reference` is the same string encoded for the
repo query parameter, so the slash is %2F and the @ is %40.
-->
